@@ -23,6 +23,9 @@
 # Strings we look for in dmesg to determine if system has suspended / resumed
 SUSPEND_MARKER="PM: suspend entry"
 RESUME_MARKER="PM: suspend exit"
+
+# When set to "true" then a call to disable_dcam_dbg is ignored
+IGNORE_DCAM_DBG_DISABLE="false"
 
 ### check_reply(reply, expectedReply)
 # Exit code 0 if reply matches expectedReply
@@ -304,3 +307,24 @@
             --signal-oneshot "${property}Changed" > /dev/null
     done
 }
+
+## This option enables the dcam_dbg framework - required for cam_dt_cmdline
+enable_dcam_dbg() {
+    send_odindb_command "camera" "enable_dcam_dbg" "Ok"
+    return $?
+}
+
+## Disables dcam_dbg framework - required for cam_dt_cmdline
+disable_dcam_dbg() {
+    if [ ${IGNORE_DCAM_DBG_DISABLE} != "true" ]; then
+        send_odindb_command "camera" "disable_dcam_dbg" "Ok"
+        return $?
+    else
+        echo "disable_dcam_dbg was ignored"
+        return 0
+    fi
+}
+
+set_ignore_disable_dcam_dbg() {
+    IGNORE_DCAM_DBG_DISABLE="true"
+}
